name: S9012
description: PNP complement to the S9013, common in Asian-design audio output and driver stages. TO-92 pin order is E-B-C (the reverse of European BC-series parts). Values shown are magnitudes; this is a PNP so the rails are negative.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: pin 1 (E) on the left. Verified from MCC and generic S901x datasheets.

typical_application: Low-voltage high-current PNP switch and push-pull/audio output complement to the S9013.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C, NOT the European C-B-E; aggregator sites sometimes mislabel it
Vceo is only 25V while Vcbo is 40V; rate by the 25V collector-emitter limit
Vebo only 5V; reverse base-emitter beyond this degrades hFE
